title: The First Spring Morning
text: As a new world began, travelers greeted one another and set out to gather food for the days ahead. Deas and Teakal exchanged morning greetings and spoke of gathering berries to stay fed. Bremvi and Laisyan agreed to work together to gather supplies and prepare for the coming days. Brearton and Thash collaborated on collecting food and discussed building a shelter as spring began. Hish crafted a basket from fibre and wood before proposing to share the gathering work with Laisyan. Fabin spoke with Vil about gathering berries, while Dor also joined them to look for food as evening approached. Bremvi exchanged pleasantries with Vaisfu, and Teakal and Brearton greeted one another in the forest.

title: Day 2: Shelter and Sustenance
text: Deas and Teakal greeted each other and agreed to work together to gather berries and food nearby. Vaisfu foraged for berries and spoke with Brearton about looking for resources to build a safe place. Bremvi and Hish discussed the shelter project, and Hish offered to help gather wood and fibre. Laisyan brought berries for Bremvi, and both continued working with Hish on the shelter. Dor made a rope from fibre before joining Fabin and Vil to try their luck at fishing as evening came.

title: Progress and Shelter on Day Three
text: Dontol arrived and offered to trade or learn new skills, while Hish spoke of future trade once their shelter was established. Laisyan, Bremvi, and Hish continued their collaborative efforts to gather wood and fibre for their shelter. Brearton and Thash repeatedly discussed and worked on gathering materials to build their own shelter for protection. Deas and Teakal gathered berries together in the area to stay well fed. Dor, Vil, and Fabin spent time fishing and noted how bountiful the water was. Dontol successfully made a basket from wood and fibre. Brearton crafted a rope from fibre. Bremvi successfully built a shelter and told Laisyan that they would feel much safer now.

title: Shelters and Sustenance
text: Deas and Teakal continued their routine of gathering berries together nearby. Bremvi and Laisyan discussed the security of their shelter while gathering more food. Laisyan successfully built a shelter as evening fell. Thash finished building a shelter and offered berries to Brearton. Dontol crafted a basket and spoke with Laisyan about gathering berries. Dor, Vil, and Fabin gathered by the water as night approached, hoping for luck with fishing before resting.

title: The Hunger of Day Five
text: Deas and Teakal agreed to continue their routine of gathering berries nearby. Dontol offered kind assistance to a hungry Laisyan by sharing food. Brearton informed Thash about grabbing berries before returning to build a shelter, which was later completed. Val also built a shelter. Dor, Vil, and Fabin dealt with their growing hunger by turning from depleted berry bushes to fish in the water as night fell. Laisyan quietly told Bremvi about going to grab nearby berries to eat in the dark.

title: Day 6 Chronicles
text: Deas and Teakal continued their routine of gathering nearby berries to stay well-fed. Bremvi shared berries with a weak Laisyan and promised to look after her strength. Vil asked Fabin and Dor for food, while Fabin and Dor focused on fishing to feed themselves and Vil. Brearton and Thash spoke about gathering more food as the season begins to turn. Dor told Fabin that he was in bad shape and needed to rest to heal after gathering berries. As darkness fell and berries grew scarce, Bremvi and Laisyan agreed to rest and find food together when morning arrives.

title: The Scarcity
text: Vaisfu spoke of foraging for supplies while Hish offered berries to those in need and crafted a basket. Bremvi and Laisyan kept their morning agreement to find food together, planning to gather nearby berries before seeking fish or deer. Fabin and Vil struggled desperately with their hunger, vowing to fish together to survive the day. Dor declared his extreme weakness and desperate need for food before ultimately starving. Dontol kindly shared berries with Laisyan and Bremvi to help them through their hunger. As night fell, Vaisfu gathered berries with Deas nearby, while Hish noted the approaching season of plenty.

title: Preparations and the Hunt
text: Bremvi informed Laisyan that the bushes were bare and went to the water to try and catch fish. Brearton and Hish exchanged greetings and agreed on the importance of gathering supplies and building a store for the upcoming season. Brearton successfully built the store and invited Hish to help fill it. Vaisfu warned Dontol to be careful with the bushes as they were being picked clean. Dontol and Lem agreed to hunt together and successfully killed a deer.

title: The Second Hunt and Sufferings
text: Dontol and Lem successfully hunted another deer and agreed to gather more berries together. Thash and Hish greeted one another and spoke about the generous bushes. Deas and Teakal spoke of gathering supplies before Teakal headed east. Brearton told Thash that the store is growing and urged him to keep gathering. Val offered safety to a hungry Bremvi, while Fabin and Laisyan both starved.
